scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man in a blue shawl gestures calmly toward an agitated man, while a tense woman watches beside them. Clay jars, a basket of figs, vines and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of a gentle answer meeting anger, with a tense onlooker suggesting the danger of harsh words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elder shows seeds and a young plant to attentive listeners while a nearby man gestures broadly as puzzled listeners watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the wise use of knowledge with foolish speech in Proverbs 15:2.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, a woman offers bread to a seated man in worn clothing while another man furtively takes a purse from a market table. Golden light falls across the people, stone buildings, and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the shared light over acts of kindness and theft to Proverbs 15:3, where Yahweh watches the evil and the good in every place.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman speaks gently to a tearful neighbor seated beneath a fruiting fig tree in a sunlit village garden; a dry broken branch lies in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes wholesome speech as a tree of life and the hurt of perverseness as a broken spirit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures toward a woodworking bench while a young man listens and rests his hands on the wood; another young man stands nearby with folded arms and looks away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Proverbs 15:5 through contrasting responses to a father’s instruction and correction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A family tends baskets of grain and fruit outside a stone house, while a distressed merchant reaches for coins spilled from a torn sack in the village street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 15:6, contrasting treasure in the house of the righteous with trouble in the earnings of the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village garden, an elder scatters seeds as he speaks to four attentive listeners; a man sits apart holding a closed pouch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the wise spreading knowledge through their words, contrasted with a person who does not share.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man tends a smoking sacrifice on an altar while a seated, needy man reaches toward him. In the foreground another man kneels in prayer with open hands.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 15:8, contrasting the sacrifice of the wicked with the prayer of the upright, which delights Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village road, a traveler helps an older man gather spilled grain beside a donkey; in a shadowed doorway, another man carries a sack away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative contrast between a caring act and a dishonest way reflects Proverbs 15:9: the LORD loves the one who pursues righteousness and rejects the way of the wicked.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older guide reaches out from a sunny winding path as a traveler raises his hand and steps onto a thorny trail beside a steep cliff. An animal skull lies among the thorns, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler rejecting correction and leaving the way, with the dangerous cliff suggesting the warning of death in Proverbs 15:10.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Golden sunlight falls across a rocky hillside and into a dark cave while a man and a woman in ancient dress stand nearby with hands over their hearts. Fields, trees, mountains and a distant village fill the landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 15:11: the hidden depths and human hearts are open before Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man walks through a sunlit stone village, raising a dismissive hand toward an older man who gestures to him. Two elders sit beneath an olive tree nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a scoffer dismissing correction and passing by the wise, inspired by Proverbs 15:12.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, a smiling woman plays a tambourine beside a musician and a clapping child, while a seated man nearby rests his head in his hand with his gaze lowered.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a cheerful countenance with the downcast posture of a sorrowful spirit, reflecting Proverbs 15:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an older man points to a plant held by a young learner, while three people nearby eat dry weeds from a bowl.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts seeking knowledge with feeding on foolishness, as in Proverbs 15:14.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary traveler sits beside his belongings in the shade of a stone courtyard while a cheerful group shares bread and fruit at a low table nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 15:15's contrast between the afflicted person's difficult days and the continual feast of a merry heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A family bows in prayer around a modest meal in a sunlit stone courtyard. Nearby, a richly dressed man sits worried beside an open chest of gold and jewels while two men argue behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 15:16's contrast between a little with reverence for Yahweh and great treasure accompanied by trouble.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling family shares leafy herbs and bread at a low wooden table in a sunlit home. Through a doorway, two richly dressed diners turn away from each other beside a lavish roast.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the proverb’s contrast between a simple meal shared with love and a rich meal accompanied by hatred.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in red gestures angrily while a man between him and an older man holds up open hands to calm their dispute. Olive trees, grapevines, pottery, and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 15:18: anger stirs strife, while patience helps calm contention.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler rests beside a narrow rocky path choked with thorny branches, while three travelers walk along a broad raised road through a sunlit landscape toward distant hills and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 15:19, contrasting the lazy person’s thorn-hedged way with the highway of the upright.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a smiling son helps his father work on a wooden cart while another young man turns away from a saddened mother reaching toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 15:20's contrast between a wise son who gladdens his father and a foolish man who despises his mother.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A laughing man tips clay pots and spills grain beside a stone-lined country road, while another man walks upright along the road. Golden fields, trees and a hillside village surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts delight in folly with the steady walk of a person of understanding in Proverbs 15:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful builder listens to four people gathered around a miniature stone bridge on a wooden table. Loose stones lie in the foreground, and a completed stone bridge crosses a stream beside a village in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 15:22: plans can go awry without counsel, while many counselors help establish them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men sit together in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath a grapevine. One smiles and gestures as he rests a hand on the other man’s shoulder; the other listens with his hands clasped. Pottery, a basket of grapes, and a hillside village surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a joyful answer and a timely word, reflecting Proverbs 15:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff climbs a sunlit stone path through wildflowers and olive trees toward a hilltop village, leaving a shadowed rocky descent behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the wise person’s upward way of life, turning away from Sheol below in Proverbs 15:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman stands in a sunlit vegetable garden enclosed by a sturdy stone boundary, while a grand stone house and its rich furnishings lie in ruins across the hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 15:25 between the proud person's ruined house and the widow's established boundary.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a woman speaks warmly to a seated neighbor, while a man in the shade glances toward them with his hand poised over a basket.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts comforting speech with a suggested harmful intention, reflecting Proverbs 15:26’s contrast between pleasant words and wicked thoughts.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man raises his palm to refuse a pouch offered by another man while a woman and two children watch from a doorway beneath an olive tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connecting the rejection of a bribe with the life affirmed in Proverbs 15:27, which also warns that greed troubles a household.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath a vine, a seated man holds a hand to his chest and listens thoughtfully while an agitated man gestures and speaks to a concerned older man nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 15:28's contrast between considering an answer and pouring out harmful speech.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels with raised hands beneath a tree as golden light breaks through clouds over a hillside village. Across the valley, a person walks away on a dark path while another kneels and reaches toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Proverbs 15:29: Yahweh is far from the wicked and hears the prayer of the righteous.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling traveler gestures as he speaks to an older man, who looks up at him joyfully with his hands clasped at his chest. Vines, clay vessels, greenery, and distant village hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of bright eyes and a welcome report bringing joy and renewed well-being, reflecting Proverbs 15:30.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man listens to an elder gesturing toward a repaired clay vessel as two companions sit nearby beneath an olive tree in a flowering village courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of someone receiving correction while sitting among wise companions, inspired by Proverbs 15:31.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pottery workshop, an older potter points to a clay vessel held by an attentive young apprentice, while another young worker turns away with folded arms beside a cracked pot.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 15:32's contrast between refusing instruction and gaining understanding by heeding correction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young learner kneels with head bowed beside a seated teacher pointing toward the sky, while an elder stands nearby holding a leafy wreath. Olive trees, pottery and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests reverent instruction in wisdom and humility preceding honor in Proverbs 15:33.
